title: Sand Castle Holds Up A Car! - Mechanically Stabilized Earth
summary: Practical Engineering explains Mechanically Stabilized Earth, where layers of reinforcement make soil strong enough to hold heavy loads, shown with a sand structure supporting a car. It notes that MSE walls are everywhere in infrastructure.
why: Often named as a great first video from Practical Engineering and as the explanation of reinforced earth.

quote.text: Practical Engineering has a great video on this simple but pervasive technology.
